notes.body:
Whole-body model of dextromethorphan and its metabolites
The circulation of the plasma through the organs, the distribution into the tissues, the oral absorption (intestine submodel), the hepatic metabolism (liver submodel with the CYP2D6 activity of the diplotype) and the renal excretion (kidney submodel). Dextromethorphan is given orally (PODOSE_dxm) or intravenously (bolus IVDOSE_dxm, infusion Ri_dxm).
The substances are dextromethorphan (dxm), dextrorphan (dxo), dextrorphan glucuronide (dxo_glu) and the lumped N-demethylated morphinans (mm: 3-methoxymorphinan, 3-hydroxymorphinan and its glucuronide, which the studies report together). The concentrations of the blood compartments are plasma concentrations, the blood to plasma ratio is 1 for every substance; the venous plasma Cve_<sid> is what the studies sample.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: The exchange flow between the plasma and the tissue of the liver, the kidney and the gut at the reference body weight BW_ref: fast against their perfusion, so the exchange does not limit the hepatic metabolism, the renal excretion or the absorption. Fixed.

GFR per renal blood flow (76.3 ml/l). Calibrated so that the healthy GFR is 101 ml/min at the renal blood flow of 1.32354 l/min of 75 kg, the normal GFR of the classes of renal impairment (pkpdsim.impairment).
The GFR of healthy kidneys, which scales with the renal blood flow and so with the body weight; the GFR is KI__f_renal_function times this rate.

parameter.name: rate of the absorption of dextromethorphan

body.p: Fixed: the step is in series with the dissolution and is not identified apart from it.
log(2) ~ 0.693 used for conversion of the half-life of the injection time to the injection rate.
O-demethylation of dextromethorphan to dextrorphan (CYP2D6), the pathway of the metabolizer phenotype: it is most of the clearance of extensive metabolizers and absent in poor metabolizers.
CYP2D6-independent O-demethylation of dextromethorphan to dextrorphan (CYP3A4, CYP2C9), the low affinity site of the microsomes; it forms the dextrorphan of poor metabolizers.
N-demethylation of dextromethorphan to 3-methoxymorphinan (CYP3A4), the main CYP2D6-independent clearance of dextromethorphan.
N-demethylation of dextrorphan to 3-hydroxymorphinan (CYP3A4); 3-hydroxymorphinan is about 16 % of an oral dose in the urine of extensive metabolizers (Capon1996, Schadel1995).
Glucuronidation of dextrorphan (UGT2B15), the main route of the dextrorphan which is formed: about 96 % of the dextrorphan of the plasma is conjugated (Nagai1996).
